newsitem.title: USA: Guaranty says to adjust Q1 EPS up to $0.10.
newsitem.headline: Guaranty says to adjust Q1 EPS up to $0.10.

text.p: Guaranty Financial Corp said Tuesday it is adjusting its first-quarter results upward to show a profit of $0.10 per share instead of a loss of $0.01 per share, based on results from a recently completed regulatory examination.
The company said the $149,673 adjustment, which it made on advice from its auditors, will show earnings of $133,520 instead of a loss of $16,153 for the quarter ended March 31.
For the six months ended December 31, 1996, the company reported a revised loss of $6,405 or $0.01 a share as compared with a previously reported profit of $147,692 or $0.16 a share.
The adjustment has no effect on net worth or previously reported book value at either date.

The company said the adjustment represents the reclassification of certain securities with market losses from the March to the December quarter as a result of a recently completed joint regulatory examination.
The company said the examination was required for the successful conversion of its primary subsidiary from a thrift institution to a commercial bank.
